posts.text:
For a 6-decimal token, 1000000 raw units is 1 token. Displaying the raw balance makes a million-fold error.

Five frontend dApp interview questions on reads, units, pending transactions, NFTs and signing.
posts.alt: Frontend dApp interview question FE-F-02 asks how to display a uint256 token balance. Example for a token with 6 decimals: viem formatUnits(1000000n, 6) returns the string '1'.

posts.text:
Q: What does a provider do in ethers or viem?

A: In ethers v6, a Provider reads chain data; a Signer authorizes transactions. In viem, Public Client exposes reads and Wallet Client handles signing via a wallet or local account.
posts.alt: Interview question FE-F-01 compares reading and signing. ethers v6: Provider reads chain data; Signer authorizes transactions. viem: Public Client exposes reads; Wallet Client handles signing through a wallet or local account.

posts.text:
Q: How do you display a uint256 token balance?

A: Use formatUnits(balance, decimals), keeping balance as bigint. In viem, formatUnits(1000000n, 6) returns '1'. Get decimals for that token and chain; never assume 18.
posts.alt: Interview question FE-F-02 on token balances. Keep the balance as bigint and use formatUnits(balance, decimals). In viem, formatUnits(1000000n, 6) returns '1'. ERC-20 decimals() is optional; if absent, use verified token metadata or label raw units rather than assuming 18.

posts.text:
Q: Why is an Ethereum transaction stuck?

A: Low fees or an earlier pending nonce can block it. Show pending status. Speed-up uses the same nonce with higher fees; cancellation competes with the original and can fail.
posts.alt: Interview question FE-I-01 asks why a transaction is stuck and how the UI should respond. Low fees or an earlier pending nonce can block it. Show pending status. Speed-up uses the same nonce with higher fees; a cancellation is a competing replacement, so the original may confirm first.

posts.text:
Q: How do you show a wallet's NFTs across contracts?

A: Query an ownership indexer by wallet and chain, paginate results, then render token IDs, metadata and images. Handle missing media. balanceOf cannot list every collection.
posts.alt: Interview question FE-A-01 on displaying a wallet's NFTs across contracts. Query an ownership indexer by wallet and chain, follow pagination, and render token IDs, metadata and images with missing-media fallbacks. A balanceOf call cannot list every collection.

posts.text:
Q: Why use EIP-712 rather than personal_sign for orders?

A: It signs typed fields with a domain, so wallets can show structured terms. Include chainId and verifyingContract. The app must still enforce nonces and expiry.
